item.description:
Labwrk 1.1.12 refreshes the menu bar pipeline indicators.
- Shows a white checkmark for passed pipelines. - Uses filled red, amber, and blue circles with pale borders for failed, warning, and running pipelines. - Reduces spacing between indicators by one point. - Preserves the existing white outline circles for next, cancelled, and nonexistent pipelines.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.11 keeps accessible pipelines refreshing when GitLab denies access to a project.
- Skips projects returning HTTP 403 during pipeline listing instead of failing the entire refresh. - Names skipped projects in a warning at the top of the panel and marks the running count as partial. - Continues refreshing other projects and records denied requests in Diagnostics. - Retries skipped projects on the next refresh and clears the warning when access recovers. - Continues with the last loaded project/group list if its refresh returns 403. - Keeps existing pipeline summaries when details are unavailable, with a warning.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.

Labwrk 1.1.10 adds diagnostic logs to help identify GitLab API access failures.
- Automatically records failed API requests with timestamps, project names and IDs, endpoints, and HTTP status codes. - Adds Settings → Preferences → Diagnostics → Show Logs in Finder. - Records network error codes without logging credentials, headers, or response bodies. - Rotates logs at approximately 1 MB and retains one previous file. - Keeps monitoring working even if a log cannot be written.
Logs begin with this version and cannot recover earlier failures. Project names are available after the project list loads; other project requests retain their ID or lookup endpoint. Logs include server hostnames and project names, so review them before sharing.
Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. This release is locally signed and has not been Apple Developer ID signed or notarized. Update archives are independently Ed25519-signed and verified by Sparkle. macOS may require per-app approval when opening a manually downloaded build.
